cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.67%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -1.99%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.body: Leaders: PWR +6.57%, LNG +5.44%, EOSE +4.97%, VRT +3.99%, BWXT +3.12%. Laggards: FTI -5.93%, MPC -3.95%, NXE -2.18%, EQT -1.96%.
